== Notes ==
* During the [[duration]], any allies adjacent to the user are affected. It disappears and reapplies if they leave and come back.
* Although moving ends the effect, [[shadow step]]ping and [[teleport]]ing do not.
* This is the only [[skill]] that can provide allied [[spirit]]s a chance to block, allowing some synergy with [[Summon Spirits]] as it moves all of your spirits to adjacent range around you.
{{anomaly|The user is affected.}}
{{anomaly|Although it has no [[activation time]], it acts like it has one (gets [[Skill queue|queued]], pauses the user, cannot be used while [[Knock down|knocked down]], etc).}}
